messages:
Emma Li: Proposal: local prefetch into lane-local KV + deferred eviction. question: avoid lease churn?
Jun Park: Use soft leases for prefetched entries. mark for compaction instead of immediate eviction.
Ryan Chen: Agree. soft leases + TTL. hard eviction only on critical headroom.
Maya Shah: How do callers opt in? admission should return a prefetch_hint score. maybe >70 triggers prefetch.
Emma Li: admit(request) -> {slot_id, lease_id, prefetch_hint:{score}} and reconcile_lease(lease_id) -> {status}.
Jun Park: Reconcile loop: escalate to hard eviction if lease mismatch >200ms (same-host) or >2s (remote).
Ryan Chen: Metrics: prefetch_hits, prefetch_aborts(reason), lease_escalations, prefetch_evictions_bailout. add to batcher dashboard.
infra-bot: Canary flag runtime.prefetch=soft flips on 1745075000 for cluster c-3. monitor p99 and lease_escalations.
Emma Li: Action items: Maya add CI hotspot test; Jun prototype escalate/reconcile; Ryan add telemetry; Emma write short RFC. +1s?
Jun Park: +1
Ryan Chen: +1
Maya Shah: +1
